name: JSONata
description: Query and transform JSON data using JSONata expressions. See https://jsonata.org for expression syntax.
syntax: JSONata( string expression, any data, [struct bindings], [struct options] )

params.name: data
params.description: JSON data to query - can be a struct, array, or JSON string.

params.name: bindings
params.description: Optional struct of variable bindings accessible in the expression. Example: { maxPrice: 100 } makes $maxPrice available.

params.name: options
params.description: Optional struct with runtime options. Supported keys: timeout (milliseconds, default 5000), maxDepth (recursion limit, default 100), functions (struct of closures/UDFs to register as custom $functions).
